question: In which element group of the periodic table are fluorine, chlorine, bromine and iodine included?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Halogen**__.

 
• **Halogen **means "Salt-producing" as they produce salt when reacts with a metal. 
 
• **Group number 17 is known as the Halogen group.**
 
• The five natural halogen elements are;
 
 
• **Fluorine **(F), atomic number **9**.
 
• **Chlorine **(Cl), atomic number **17.**
 
• Bromine </stro
